"""Sample entry point: one import of each origin, and calls of each resolvable kind."""

import hashlib  # stdlib
import numpy as np  # third_party, alias np
from billing.engine import accrue  # internal: billing/ is under src/
from flask import request  # third_party

from . import helpers  # internal: relative


def handle():
    helpers.log(request)
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    total = accrue(np.zeros(1), digest)
    return total, undefined_thing()
